Backbone: single-domain helical binder
Length: 96 residues (positions 1-96)

Fixed functional positions (interface triad -- must be preserved exactly):
  position 24 = Y (Tyr)
  position 48 = W (Trp)
  position 72 = R (Arg)

These three residues make the binding interface; the backbone was built around
them. Everything else is yours to design.

Composition notes: aim for a realistic, diverse globular-domain sequence. Avoid
long single-residue runs and avoid loading up on any one amino acid.
